notes: Fiscal-year mapping: historical fiscal years are McKesson years ended March 31 (FY2023, FY2024, FY2025).

EBIT is proxied by GAAP operating income from the Consolidated Statements of Operations (includes restructuring/impairment and other operating items). ([s24.q4cdn.com](https://s24.q4cdn.com/128197368/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/MCK_10-K_3-31-2025-FINAL-WITH-EXHIBITS.pdf))

D&A is proxied by cash flow line items (depreciation + amortization). Capex is proxied as PP&E cash payments plus capitalized software cash payments. ([s24.q4cdn.com](https://s24.q4cdn.com/128197368/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/MCK_10-K_3-31-2025-FINAL-WITH-EXHIBITS.pdf))

NWC definition: operating working capital excludes cash and interest-bearing financing items; computed as (Receivables + Inventories + Prepaid expenses and other) minus (Drafts and accounts payable + Other accrued liabilities), based on year-end balance sheet line items. This yields negative NWC (wholesaler dynamic). ([s24.q4cdn.com](https://s24.q4cdn.com/128197368/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/MCK_10-K_3-31-2025-FINAL-WITH-EXHIBITS.pdf))

Tax rate set to 0.19 as an average of reported effective rates over FY2023-FY2025; FY tax rates were influenced by discrete items. ([s24.q4cdn.com](https://s24.q4cdn.com/128197368/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/MCK_10-K_3-31-2025-FINAL-WITH-EXHIBITS.pdf))

WACC set to 0.0754 from AlphaSpread’s discount-rate tool. Terminal growth (0.02) and NOL utilization (0.80) are modeling assumptions not disclosed explicitly in filings and should be stress-tested in sensitivity runs. ([alphaspread.com](https://www.alphaspread.com/security/nyse/mck/discount-rate))

Investments input left null because the pipeline balance-sheet adjustment convention (separate 'investments' line vs 'other non-current assets'/equity securities) is not uniquely specified by the schema and would require an explicit modeling convention beyond the collected primary line items.

catalysts: Successful execution of the Medical-Surgical Solutions separation (timing, structure, and stated value-creation rationale). ([mckesson.com](https://www.mckesson.com/about-us/newsroom/press-releases/2025/mckesson-reports-fiscal-2025-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-results/))

Sustained outperformance in oncology and biopharma services platforms and continued share gains/volume growth in distribution. ([mckesson.com](https://www.mckesson.com/about-us/newsroom/press-releases/2025/mckesson-reports-fiscal-2025-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-results/))
Capital allocation discipline (buybacks/dividends) and maintaining working-capital efficiency to support free cash flow.
company_overview: McKesson is a leading healthcare services company with large-scale pharmaceutical distribution and specialty services.
The company’s model includes distribution/logistics and higher-value offerings such as oncology and biopharma services platforms.
McKesson announced its intent to separate Medical-Surgical Solutions into an independent company (NewCo), reflecting portfolio focus on higher-growth/higher-margin areas.
current_context: Fiscal 2025 results: consolidated revenues of $359.1B (+16%) and FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance range of $36.75 to $37.55 (mid-teens growth ex certain investment gains), alongside continued capital deployment commentary. ([mckesson.com](https://www.mckesson.com/about-us/newsroom/press-releases/2025/mckesson-reports-fiscal-2025-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-results/))

Portfolio update: intent to separate Medical-Surgical Solutions into a stand-alone company to sharpen capital allocation and operating focus. ([mckesson.com](https://www.mckesson.com/about-us/newsroom/press-releases/2025/mckesson-reports-fiscal-2025-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-results/))
Market context for the DCF setup uses the latest available equity price in the research window (last trade dated 2026-03-20).
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth assumes continued demand and execution-supported momentum, anchored to the company’s recent 16% FY2025 top-line growth. ([mckesson.com](https://www.mckesson.com/about-us/newsroom/press-releases/2025/mckesson-reports-fiscal-2025-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-results/))

EBIT margin progression is gradual and realistic, reflecting historically low operating-income margins but modest operating leverage over the forecast horizon. ([s24.q4cdn.com](https://s24.q4cdn.com/128197368/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/MCK_10-K_3-31-2025-FINAL-WITH-EXHIBITS.pdf))

Cash conversion is supported by consistently negative operating NWC (wholesaler-like model); the model holds operating NWC as a stable negative % of sales. ([s24.q4cdn.com](https://s24.q4cdn.com/128197368/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/MCK_10-K_3-31-2025-FINAL-WITH-EXHIBITS.pdf))

Reinvestment intensity is modeled via capex and D&A as % of sales based on recent cash flow disclosure, including capitalized software. ([s24.q4cdn.com](https://s24.q4cdn.com/128197368/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/MCK_10-K_3-31-2025-FINAL-WITH-EXHIBITS.pdf))
Discount rate is based on an externally parameterized WACC input for QA consistency across pipelines. ([alphaspread.com](https://www.alphaspread.com/security/nyse/mck/discount-rate))
key_risks: Margin compression from competitive/price pressure and/or mix shifts, particularly given historically low GAAP operating margins. ([s24.q4cdn.com](https://s24.q4cdn.com/128197368/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/MCK_10-K_3-31-2025-FINAL-WITH-EXHIBITS.pdf))

Working-capital volatility (receivables, payables, and accrual timing) impacting operating NWC and free cash flow. ([s24.q4cdn.com](https://s24.q4cdn.com/128197368/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/MCK_10-K_3-31-2025-FINAL-WITH-EXHIBITS.pdf))

Regulatory, litigation, and reimbursement risks common to healthcare distribution and services. ([s24.q4cdn.com](https://s24.q4cdn.com/128197368/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/MCK_10-K_3-31-2025-FINAL-WITH-EXHIBITS.pdf))

valuation_summary: DCF base case ties forecast revenue growth to an explicit chain from FY2025 revenue and uses consistent margin/cash-flow proxies (EBIT, D&A, capex, and operating NWC). ([s24.q4cdn.com](https://s24.q4cdn.com/128197368/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/MCK_10-K_3-31-2025-FINAL-WITH-EXHIBITS.pdf))

Public comps include distribution/specialty peers using forward-leaning EV multiples and forward P/E proxies to sanity-check the terminal value region. ([alphaspread.com](https://www.alphaspread.com/security/f/mck/relative-valuation/ratio/enterprise-value-to-revenue))
Scenario framework adjusts only a small set of economically meaningful levers (growth, margin, WACC, terminal growth) to avoid overfitting.
